origin_classes.P: population prior (literature value, not measured on this dataset)
origin_classes.F: fitted (fitted_to states what it was fitted to)

connectome.sugar_knn.fitted_to: leave-one-out classification of the left LB3 neurons (Shiu sugar vs other) on FlyWire v783; k=5 gave 19/20 sugar, 2/44 false positives (Synaptera v1 selection, anatomy only)

connectome.nt_modulatory.source: dopamine, serotonin and octopamine act as slow neuromodulators; the Shiu model nevertheless treats them as fast excitation. Classification from the Synaptera v1 --nt-modulatory-silent decision (SPEC_BRAIN_CONTROL Step 0 decisions II); used only by the named model variant 'silent'

connectome.pred_sign_shiu.source: Shiu et al. 2023 model rule: every transmitter other than GABA / glutamate is excitatory; used by the 'impute' variant to give a predicted neuron its vote. HIST and TYR (BANC) have no entry on purpose: F1 decision

connectome.fast_nt_sign.source: Shiu et al. 2023 sign mapping for the three fast transmitters (ACh excitatory; GABA, glutamate inhibitory); applied to the literature transmitter of Schlegel et al. 2024 known_nt by the 'literature' variant
